label: the deep dunes outpost
note: Issue #64: one of the Remnant's three desert outposts out the front gate (near, mid, far: each further out and a little different). Set in the world as a landmark (content/core/worlds/port_desert.json), so ships and speeders collide with the building. Local frame: +x faces the town. 'visual': false = no placeholder box; src/systems/world/remnant_outposts.gd dresses it dark grey, black and red, parks the 'ship' at the 'ship' point (issue #76: the Remnant's dark interceptor or freighter, flyable: boarding it sets off the outpost's alarm), and puts three troopers (outpost_trooper) at guard_a / guard_b / guard_c, an assassin droid walking 'patrol', a floating droid on 'floater' and a cargo droid shuffling along 'cargo' (issue #76: it runs into the desert on the alarm and is left there broken), and a bounty target (bounty_target) at 'target' when Oda's contract names this outpost. 'look' says what makes this one different. Issue #76: 'props' are the crates, canisters and drums lying about (solid: cover); 'stack' piles that many, 'lying' tips one on its side.

zone.note: Issue #308: a ring of radius metres round the outpost is a checkpoint zone. Below the wave band the nearest trooper (a role below) who sees you walks up and the gate's card opens, on the gate's rules (content/core/soldiers/gate_guard.json checkpoint block; anything in this checkpoint block wins). Leave the ring and the card closes; cleared, the outpost leaves you alone for cleared_s.
